items.takeaway: Hi everyone. Long time. I figured there might be some interest in a rerun of this, so let's get into it. IC Form Kits A new <> key has been added for ISO users. Some positions in the 65% column have been moved around for aesthetic reasons and to help streamline new mold costs for the 40s kit below. Special thanks to HaiZeus for his help on this 40s kit and for getting the ball rolling on this rerun in the first place .
